instructions: See docs/ratings.md. Give every season a rating on the absolute scale. Rate the player that season, never their career.

seasons.note: The controller of an unbeaten double-winning side and the best season of his career; elite, and four points clear of the thirty-two-year-old at Sunderland.
Ukraine captain and a Champions League semi-finalist with Dynamo Kyiv the season before; solid rather than the liability he is remembered as.
A first Bayern season spent mostly at right-back and prone to the lapse; the raw defending was already better than the performances.
Comfortably the most gifted forward in this tier at 19 — close to an England call-up within three years before a motorcycle accident.
His one full season at his level: ten goals, a League Cup winner and close to the England squad before the accident.
A motorcycle accident in mid-2002 left him with a head injury he never recovered his game from; the drop is the injury, not a loss of form.
Nineteen goals for a side that finished fifth is the output of a much better player than he was before or after; rated up for the season, not to the level the tally alone would suggest.
Newcastle’s player of the season in a side that went down — composed, quick and comfortable enough to earn a Tottenham move.
A Champions League final scorer and Serie A title winner the season before; rated on the finishing, not on the club being relegated around him.
Thirty-two and five years on from Middlesbrough, having been through Marseille, Lazio and Derby; nine goals in a relegated side, with the finishing intact and nothing else.

The loan spell was brief and unremarkable, but at twenty-seven this was an Italy international full-back with Champions League medals at Milan and Real Madrid and a Roma title still to come. Rated on the footballer.
A first-choice full back in a Roma side that finished second, but he is thirty-three here and rated level with, not above, the twenty-seven-year-old of the Chelsea row.
Six goals and five assists at seventeen is remarkable, and the finishing instinct was genuine; the rest of his game was not yet there.
Two league starts in a title-winning season after a serious ankle injury; the finishing was still there, the rest of his game had stopped developing.
Twenty-four league goals and four against Real Madrid in a Champions League semi-final; at twenty-three the complete centre-forward profile was already there.
